sections.text: IGH/CCND2 rearrangements were detected by FISH in three of 40 cyclin-D1-negative, SOX11-positive mantle cell lymphomas. These are distinct from the more frequent CCND2 rearrangements involving immunoglobulin light-chain loci.

report_comment.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus involved in B-cell antigen-receptor diversity. CCND2 encodes cyclin D2, a regulator of CDK4/6-dependent cell-cycle progression. IGH/CCND2 rearrangements were detected by FISH in three of 40 cyclin-D1-negative, SOX11-positive mantle cell lymphomas. These are distinct from the more frequent CCND2 rearrangements involving immunoglobulin light-chain loci.
